lines.text_source: [10][02]Fishing equipment can be[01]bought in towns and[01]villages.[02]It's probably a good idea[01]to buy a lot ahead of time[01]so you're always prepared![02]If your line gets [05][02]caught[01]on the bottom[06] or [05][02]breaks[06],[01]you lose a lure, but[02]if you have more than one[01]of that lure, it's[01]automatically replaced![11]

lines.base_translation: [10][02]Equipamentos de pesca podem[01]ser comprados em cidades e[01]vilarejos.[02]E uma boa ideia comprar[01]bastante com antecedencia[01]para estar sempre pronto![02]Se sua linha [05][02]prender[01]no fundo[06] ou [05][02]arrebentar[06],[01]voce perde uma isca, mas[02]se tiver mais de uma[01]igual, ela sera[01]reposta automaticamente![11]

lines.text_source: [10][02]Aim for shady areas, or[01]places where you can see[01]fish swimming.[02]This increases your chances[01]of getting a big fish or a[01]rare type of fish.[02]Different fish live in[01]different areas--some swim[01]near the surface,[02]while others live near the[01]bottom.[02]The trick to catching a[01]fish is to get it to notice[01]your lure.[02]Depending on the area, some[01]fish may go behind rocks as[01]you try to reel them in.[02]In that case, move your[01]rod back and forth to ease[01]the fish out from behind[02]the rock--but be careful[01]not to break your line![11]

lines.intent: Dicas de onde lancar para pegar peixes melhores
lines.base_translation: [10][02]Mire em areas sombreadas[01]ou onde ver peixes[01]nadando.[02]Isso aumenta as chances[01]de pegar um peixe grande[01]ou raro.[02]Peixes diferentes vivem em[01]areas diferentes--alguns[01]nadam perto da superficie,[02]enquanto outros ficam[01]perto do fundo.[02]O segredo e fazer o peixe[01]notar sua isca.[02]Dependendo da area, alguns[01]peixes podem se esconder[01]atras de pedras ao[02]ser recolhidos--mas[01]cuidado para nao arrebentar[01]a linha![11]

lines.text_source: [10][02]When reeling in a fish,[01]the faster you pull, the[01]better.[02]If you reel when line[01]tension is weak, the lure[01]won't drop off,[02]and if you let off the reel[01]when tension is high, the[01]line won't break.[02]To reel in a fish, you must[01]keep the tension within the[01]range shown on the screen.[02]You can wear out a fish[01]faster by moving your rod[02]back and forth or in the[01]opposite direction of the[01]fish.[11]
lines.speaker: system
lines.intent: Dicas de recolhimento do peixe e controle de tensao
lines.base_translation: [10][02]Ao recolher um peixe,[01]quanto mais rapido puxar,[01]melhor.[02]Se recolher com tensao[01]fraca, a isca nao cai,[02]e se soltar a linha com[01]tensao alta, ela nao[01]arrebenta.[02]Para recolher o peixe,[01]mantenha a tensao na[01]faixa indicada na tela.[02]Voce cansa o peixe mais[01]rapido movendo a vara[02]de um lado para o outro[01]ou na direcao oposta[01]ao peixe.[11]

lines.text_source: [10][02]You can use fish you've[01]caught as items,[02]or trade them at the[01]Manillo Shop for rare and[01]hard-to-find items.[11]

lines.text_source: [0C][02]Continuing to reel a lure[01]when it hits bottom can[01]cause it to catch.
lines.speaker: system
lines.intent: Recolher isca no fundo pode prende-la
lines.base_translation: [0C][02]Continuar recolhendo a isca[01]quando ela toca o fundo[01]pode prende-la.

lines.text_source: [0C][02]If your lure gets caught on[01]the bottom, you lose your[01]lure.[02]Be careful to avoid getting[01]your lure caught as you[01]reel it in.
lines.speaker: system
lines.intent: Avisar que isca presa no fundo e perdida
lines.base_translation: [0C][02]Se a isca prender no fundo,[01]voce a perde.[02]Tome cuidado para nao[01]prender a isca ao[01]recolhe-la.

lines.text_source: [0C][02]If you press the ~ button[01]rhythmically as you reel[01]your lure in,[02]you can make it appear more[01]attractive to fish.
lines.speaker: system
lines.intent: Dica de pressionar o botao ritmicamente para atrair peixes
lines.base_translation: [0C][02]Se pressionar ~ de forma[01]ritmica ao recolher[01]a isca,[02]ela ficara mais atraente[01]para os peixes.

lines.text_source: [0C][02]The more attractive your[01]lure is,[02]the better chance you have[01]of catching a fish.
lines.speaker: system
lines.intent: Quanto mais atraente a isca, mais chance de pescar
lines.base_translation: [0C][02]Quanto mais atraente[01]a isca,[02]maior a chance de[01]capturar um peixe.

lines.text_source: [0C][02]If a fish becomes[01]interested in your lure,[02]the tension on the line[01]will increase.

lines.intent: Peixe interessado aumenta tensao da linha
lines.base_translation: [0C][02]Se um peixe se interessar[01]pela isca,[02]a tensao da linha[01]vai aumentar.

lines.text_source: [0C][02]This is called "getting a[01]bite."[02]However, it does not mean[01]the fish has taken the[01]bait.[02]You must get the fish to[01]take the bait. This is[01]called "hooking."
lines.speaker: system
lines.base_translation: [0C][02]Isso se chama "picada."[02]Porem, nao significa[01]que o peixe mordeu[01]a isca.[02]Voce precisa fazer o peixe[01]morder. Isso se chama[01]"fisgada."

lines.text_source: [0C][02]When you get a bite on your[01]lure,
lines.speaker: system

lines.text_source: [0C][02]the tension on your line[01]will increase.[02]If you press the button[01]with just the right[01]timing,[02]you'll be able to get[01]it to grab the lure.
lines.speaker: system
lines.intent: Tensao aumenta e timing correto para fisgar
lines.base_translation: [0C][02]a tensao da linha[01]vai aumentar.[02]Se pressionar o botao[01]no momento certo,[02]voce consegue fazer[01]o peixe morder a isca.

lines.text_source: [0C][02]This is called "hooking."[02]You can press any button[01]other than the ~ button[01]to try and hook a fish.[02]Once you feel a bite, try[01]to hook the fish as fast[01]as you can.
lines.speaker: system
lines.intent: Explicar o que e fisgada e como fazer
lines.base_translation: [0C][02]Isso se chama "fisgada."[02]Voce pode pressionar[01]qualquer botao exceto ~[01]para tentar fisgar.[02]Ao sentir a picada, tente[01]fisgar o peixe o mais[01]rapido possivel.

lines.text_source: [0C][02]Sometimes, you can hook a[01]fish when it bites without[01]doing anything.
lines.speaker: system
lines.base_translation: [0C][02]As vezes, o peixe e fisgado[01]automaticamente ao morder,[01]sem fazer nada.

lines.text_source: [0C][02]In these cases, the chance[01]of losing your lure is[01]higher than normal.[02]Be careful not to let the[01]fish get away with your[01]lure.
lines.speaker: system
lines.intent: Risco maior de perder isca em fisgada automatica
lines.base_translation: [0C][02]Nesses casos, o risco de[01]perder a isca e maior[01]que o normal.[02]Cuidado para nao deixar[01]o peixe fugir com[01]a isca.

lines.text_source: [0C][02]Once a fish has been[01]hooked,[02]the tension on the line[01]will change based on the[01]fish's movement.
lines.speaker: system
lines.intent: Tensao muda conforme movimento do peixe apos fisgada
lines.base_translation: [0C][02]Apos fisgar o peixe,[02]a tensao da linha muda[01]conforme o movimento[01]do peixe.

lines.text_source: [0C][02]You can adjust the tension[01]by reeling in your lure[01](using the ~ button).[02]Reeling in the lure causes[01]the tension to increase,
lines.speaker: system
lines.intent: Explicar como ajustar tensao recolhendo a isca
lines.base_translation: [0C][02]Voce pode ajustar a tensao[01]recolhendo a isca[01](usando ~).[02]Recolher a isca aumenta[01]a tensao,

lines.text_source: [0C][02]and letting the lure play[01]out decreases the tension.
lines.speaker: system
lines.intent: Soltar a linha diminui a tensao

lines.text_source: [0C][02]If the tension level moves[01]to the right of the target[01]area when reeling,[02]your line may break under[01]the pressure.
lines.speaker: system
lines.intent: Tensao alta demais pode arrebentar a linha
lines.base_translation: [0C][02]Se a tensao passar para[01]a direita da area alvo[01]ao recolher,[02]a linha pode arrebentar[01]sob a pressao.

lines.text_source: [0C][02]On the other hand, if the[01]tension level moves to the[01]left of the target area,[02]the fish will get away with[01]your lure if you don't reel[01]it in.
lines.speaker: system
lines.intent: Tensao baixa demais pode perder a isca
lines.base_translation: [0C][02]Por outro lado, se a tensao[01]for para a esquerda da[01]area alvo,[02]o peixe fuge com a isca[01]se voce nao recolher[01]a tempo.

lines.text_source: [0C][02]If the line breaks, not[01]only do you lose the fish[01]but your lure as well.
lines.speaker: system
lines.intent: Linha quebrada perde o peixe e a isca
lines.base_translation: [0C][02]Se a linha arrebentar,[01]voce perde o peixe[01]e a isca tambem.

lines.text_source: [0C][02]Be careful not to let the[01]tension get above or below[01]the target area.
lines.speaker: system
lines.intent: Cuidado para manter tensao na area alvo
lines.base_translation: [0C][02]Cuidado para nao deixar[01]a tensao sair da[01]area alvo.
